title: Apocalypse dreams
content: I’ve been having repeat apocalypse style dreams. Usually I’m on the run with my family. We are traveling through different locations, none that seem recognizable in my day to day life but feel familiar. Lots of outdoor spaces - a giant park, the beach with a large house, a large mansion grounds. We are being chased by faceless people -sometimes they’re from the government and dressed in protective health outfits like how doctors look in surgery. Slowly my family is either killed off or kill’s themselves. Sometimes I end up in a tundra space.
